• Just now
Seen • Just now
Yes, you can update the address, but it depends on what kind of order it is. If it’s a Kajabi purchase, you can edit the contact info tied to the transaction (this is what shows on the receipt).  
Steps:
From your Kajabi dashboard, click Sales.
Click Payments.
Click Transactions.
Find the transaction and click the transaction Amount (or click … and choose View more details).
Click … → Edit receipt contact information.
Update the address and click Save.
Note: editing receipt contact info is not available for transactions made through Cart.
If you meant a physical product order from a creator’s site (not Kajabi), you’ll need to ask that creator to update it.

Can I cancel an order after placing it, and is there a time window?
• Just now
Seen • Just now
Yes, you can cancel, but it depends on what kind of order it was, and there isn’t a universal “time window” for all purchases. 
If it was a gift offer delivery (a gift you bought for someone), you can cancel only while it’s still pending. Once it’s delivered, it can’t be modified. 
If it was a subscription or payment plan, you can cancel future payments from the transaction, and you can choose when it ends (end of current billing period, a custom date, or cancel now).  
If it was a one-time purchase (no future payments), there isn’t a “cancel” option, but access can be revoked.
